title: Left Behind
author: Tim LaHaye
summary: Millions of people vanish in an instant, and airline pilot Rayford Steele and journalist Buck Williams try to understand what has happened. The novel is based on a Christian view of the end times.
readIf: you want an evangelical end-times thriller with short chapters and a brisk pace.
skipIf: you do not share its theology or prefer more nuanced character writing.
